name: Okasare Yuusha V ~ Donna ni Level o Agete mo, Sugu Shasei Shichau Boku no Ochinchin...~
original_name: 犯され勇者Ⅴ～どんなにレベルを上げても、すぐ射精しちゃうボクのおちんちん…～
source:
Elysia, the Ten Worlds: a universe under rule of monster musumes.

At the lowest of the Ten Worlds you live in fear and oppression, wondering if there was some way to change things.

One day, an angel appears to you with news that you've been
chosen to liberate Elysia from its rulers.

Not knowing quite what to do, you are anointed hero by the strangely wicked angel, and take a sexual rite of passage for divine protection.

Your journey will take you across the Ten Worlds and pit you against beautiful, ravenously sexual monsters.
If you should fail, a sperm-drenched hell of rapegirls is waiting.

Can you save all the worlds from monmusu tyranny!?
Or will the sexy rulers choke out every last drop of your creamy vitality!?

The battle for Elysia, and your adventure as its savior, begins now...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE137860.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
艾丽西亚，十个世界：怪物娘们统治下的宇宙。

在十个世界的最低层，你生活在恐惧和压迫中，想知道是否有某种方法可以改变事情。

有一天，一位天使出现在你面前，带来了你已经去过的消息
选择将艾丽西亚从统治者手中解放出来。

由于不知道该怎么做，你被奇怪邪恶的天使膏为英雄，并接受了神圣保护的性仪式。

你的旅程将带你穿越十个世界，并让你对抗美丽、贪婪的性怪物。
如果你失败了，等待你的是一群充满精液的强奸女孩地狱。

你能从文武苏的暴政中拯救所有的世界吗！？
还是性感的统治者会扼杀你最后一滴奶油般的活力！？

艾丽西亚之战，以及你作为艾丽西亚救世主的冒险，现在开始……
